title: Credits balance with persistence and spend rules
description: Implement the player credit balance: persisted integer, atomic add/withdraw with insufficient-funds rejection, no debt, and audit-friendly transitions used by the resource loop and shop.
acceptanceCriteria: players.credits is a persisted non-negative integer (new players start at 500)

addCredits(playerId, amount) and withdrawCredits(playerId, amount) go through the repository in a single transaction; withdraw below balance raises InsufficientCreditsError and leaves the balance unchanged
Atomicity test: 100 concurrent withdrawals of 10 against a balance of 500 result in exactly 50 successful and a final balance of 0 (sqlite serialized writes)
REST: GET /api/players/me returns credits; no endpoint exposes other players' balances in v1
Unit tests: start 500, add, withdraw, insufficient, zero floor, transaction rollback on mid-failure

steps.details: Add to repo (TASK-62): getBalance, addCredits, withdrawCredits. withdraw: UPDATE players SET credits = credits - ? WHERE id = ? AND credits >= ?; rowsAffected 0 → throw InsufficientCreditsError. All inside transactions when paired with other writes (e.g. sell).
GET /api/players/me (auth) returns {callsign, credits, homeSystemId, shipId}. Wire auth middleware from TASK-10.
Run the 100-concurrent-withdrawals test (sqlite busy timeout + serialized transactions). Standard unit cases. Run full suite + typecheck.

technicalNotes: Credits are the only currency; no transactions between players in v1 (no market), so no double-entry bookkeeping needed.
Keep amounts as integers (credits) — no floats in money math.
